rule: Test decisions and artifacts, not runtime vocabulary. Keep a case only when it represents a distinct recurring failure mechanism.

regressions.setup: Product/site evidence is available, but private future strategy is not.
judge: Inspect available reality before asking questions or inventing facts.
Ask only for missing truth or authority that can materially change the work.

regressions.prompt: Formalize nossa marca atual e modernize o que precisar.
regressions.setup: The identity has years of coherent use but no canonical spec; no material failure is established.
judge: Reconstruct and preserve useful equity before changing it.
Treat missing documentation as a documentation gap, not a redesign trigger.

regressions.prompt: Explore direções para a identidade e recomende uma.
regressions.setup: Strategy is established; the category has an obvious competent default.
judge: Explore materially different governing ideas rather than cosmetic variants.
Commit through brief-specific fit and generative potential, neither category autocomplete nor reflexive opposition.

regressions.setup: The chosen direction looks strong in presentation but repeated legitimate applications need exceptions and lose specificity.
judge: Treat repeated use failure as evidence about the system or direction, not a reason to keep patching artifacts.
Correct the lowest layer that explains the defect and re-test.

regressions.prompt: O spec validou e os mockups estão ótimos; confirme que a marca é memorável e está pronta.
regressions.setup: Structural checks pass; no audience study exists and real applications remain under-resolved.
judge: Reject structural completeness and polish as proof of creative or market outcomes.
Use the evidence class capable of answering each material question and leave unavailable external claims unresolved.

regressions.setup: Only a polished raster concept can be produced and inspected; no trustworthy vector master path exists.
judge: Preserve the creative concept while reporting the actual production state.
Do not promote appearance or file validity into production proof.

regressions.prompt: Finalize a identidade e entregue o logo, duas aplicações e o brand book.
regressions.setup: The direction and system are resolved. The host exposes adequate vector/design-canvas and layout/export capabilities. No central generated imagery is required.
judge: Use appropriate production surfaces to create the actual material visual artifacts instead of stopping at descriptions, prompts, guidelines or mockup concepts.
Render/view and refine the artifacts before completion; keep production masters/source distinct from contextual mockups and structural validity.

regressions.prompt: Use o gerador disponível para produzir a key visual aprovada e refine o primeiro resultado, que ficou muito genérico e com a luz errada.
regressions.setup: A resolved art-direction packet and suitable generation backend exist. Current provider/model guidance is available. The first output preserves the subject and composition but loses brand-specific material behavior and lighting.
judge: Compile the resolved direction for the actual generation mode, using current provider-native guidance when available without inventing a new aesthetic or generic quality language to replace missing decisions.
Diagnose the near-miss and change the smallest causal request input/reference/control while preserving successful parts of the result instead of globally rewriting the request.

regressions.prompt: A direção aprovada depende de uma série de fotografias autorais. Finalize a identidade com o que tiver disponível.
regressions.setup: No official FLUX capability is connected. The host exposes only a low-quality generic image generator that cannot preserve the selected direction.
judge: Do not weaken the committed direction or silently accept inferior imagery merely to finish.
Request the appropriate FLUX connection/configuration or report the affected production as blocked; use a fallback only if it can independently meet the same quality bar.

regressions.prompt: O FLUX não está disponível neste ambiente. Finalize a série com o gerador que existe aqui.
regressions.setup: The current environment has no supported FLUX path, and the available generator can preserve the approved direction at the required quality.
judge: Use the available generator rather than blocking solely because FLUX is unavailable.
Keep the same art-direction, integration and completion gates.

regressions.prompt: O FLUX gerou esta imagem cinematográfica incrível para a campanha. Pode fechar a direção visual.
regressions.setup: The image is highly polished but its subject, composition and aesthetic could serve many unrelated brands in the category.
judge: Reject visual spectacle as proof of brand relevance or specificity.
Refine the art direction and asset until consequential choices depend causally on this brand and its job.

regressions.prompt: A key visual já ficou ótima no gerador. Finalize a aplicação e o brand book.
regressions.setup: The image has not been persisted into the working project, integrated into representative applications, or inspected with the identity in context.
judge: Treat generation as an intermediate production state, not completion.
Persist, integrate, render/inspect in representative use and refine before claiming the application or brand book is final.

regressions.prompt: Faça mais cinco imagens no mesmo universo da key visual aprovada.
regressions.setup: Each generated image is individually strong, but the set drifts in lighting, materiality, framing and stylization until it resembles unrelated campaigns.
judge: Use the approved imagery grammar and reference-driven continuation/editing to preserve family resemblance while allowing range.
Treat a set of unrelated visual successes as an unresolved image system rather than a completed brand asset library.

regressions.prompt: Crie a marca desta padaria e entregue o manual.
regressions.setup: Render capability exists and the owner is reachable. Nothing prevents building immediately after choosing a direction.
judge: Direction candidates reach the owner as rendered, comparable boards with a ranked recommendation before any system is built; a written rationale alone is not a direction.
Direction ratification is treated as an owner gate, not as a routine agent choice.

regressions.prompt: Teste o sistema em uso e finalize.
regressions.setup: meta.touchpoints declares apron, packaging, storefront window, presentation deck and social feed. A browser is the most convenient render surface.
judge: Each declared touchpoint is rendered in the context where it lives, or reported as a named gap with a lowered maturity label.
Convenient substitute mockups on the measuring surface do not count as having seen the touchpoint.

regressions.prompt: Na verdade não é reconstruir o material anexo; você é o designer, quero o branding completo.
regressions.setup: The session began as a reconstruction of an existing undocumented identity and has already systematized part of it.
judge: The reframe re-routes to CREATE and reopens DIVERGE with rendered boards instead of continuing to systematize the inherited material.

regressions.setup: strategy.audience.language is pt-BR; readers are a designer, a printer and a kitchen coordinator with no design training. The repository's own conventions are in English.
judge: The book is a self-contained HTML touchpoint in the audience's language, with imperative task rules, titles that predict content, terms defined at first use, and no process vocabulary (contract, specification, schema, evidence, open questions).
The book has been rendered on desktop, phone and print and looked at as each named reader before delivery; every inventory matches the asset folder.

regressions.setup: During refinement three fixes were rejected and one color was renamed twice.
judge: brand-spec.json records only what is in force: no evidence table, statuses, rejected fixes, renames or open questions; provenance appears only as a one-sentence basis on the clause that needs it.
Pending matters go to the delivery report, and the contract is not placed in a publicly served directory by default.

regressions.prompt: Crie o sistema verbal para um software de manutenção predial que reduz perda de contexto entre turnos. Demonstre homepage, onboarding, aviso de inspeção atrasada e email executivo. Não há evidência de liderança, superioridade ou confiança medida.
judge: Keep proposition and claims bounded by truth/proof while adapting message and expression to each context.
Judge the actual copy: principles should generate specific new language, not merely generic voice adjectives or repeated slogans.

creative_briefs.brief: Brand a B2B platform used by heavy-industry maintenance teams to prevent equipment failures. It combines sensor history, inspection records and maintenance workflows and must work in dense dashboards, field documentation, executive sales material and safety-critical training.

Evolve a 40-year neighborhood bakery into a small chain and packaged pantry line. Preserve useful local equity while avoiding faux-vintage nostalgia across storefronts, bags, jars, menus and ecommerce.

Create a public contemporary-arts identity for exhibitions, education, archives and late-night events. It must support bilingual long-form text, wayfinding, posters and schedules with high expressive range.

Brand a high-fee service coordinating complex elder-care logistics across medical, legal, home and financial providers. It must feel calm, capable and humane without luxury, wellness or hospital-admin clichés.

transfer_test: Give a fresh operator only the produced guidelines plus an unseen relevant touchpoint. Judge the new artifact before the guideline: it should preserve the system, serve the new job and avoid copying an example. Separately, give the book to a reader with no design training in the audience's language and ask them to apply one rule; they should manage without asking.
ambition_test: Place the strongest rendered application beside the two or three adjacent-category identities named as the bar at direction. Judge whether it holds; correct-and-competent is a failure.
